name: Samuel's Remains
summary: Near Deathknell, Samuel’s bones are taken from a Scourge thrall and laid beside Marla.

sections.title: A Tragic Reunion
sections.body:
Samuel Fipps and his wife Marla lived in peace in Tirisfal Glades before undeath’s plague swept across Lordaeron. Samuel succumbed and became a mindless servant of the Scourge. Marla escaped undeath, but Samuel struck her down. As she died, she asked to be buried beside him once his cursed form was laid to rest.

Novice Elreth in Deathknell sends newly awoken Forsaken northeast of the settlement. There they must find Samuel’s wandering form, recover his bones, and bury them in the front row of the local cemetery.

faq.answer: Samuel Fipps was a human who lived in Tirisfal Glades before the Third War. The Scourge plague killed him and raised him as an undead thrall of the Lich King. Driven by mindless hunger, he eventually slew his wife, Marla.
Samuel’s remains are recovered from his wandering form at a ruined camp along the road northeast of Deathknell. Ending his mindless existence allows his bones to be retrieved.

faq.q: Why do the Forsaken bury him beside his wife?
faq.answer: Marla’s dying wish was to rest beside her beloved husband, though he killed her. Novice Elreth honors her request to show that the newly liberated Forsaken still have compassion, respect for the dead, and the humanity that sets them apart from the Scourge.

angles.text: As an undead, you learn early that honoring the tragic dead marks the moral divide between free Forsaken and the Scourge’s mindless thralls.
